correctness.rationale: By An Proposition5.1 the top H4 over any field is Hom_{F3[S4]}(sgn,D(a)⊗D(b)). For a,b>=7, the 4-row chessboard complex has free top homology and shellability supplies a projective chain resolution. Its V4-trivial block has (x-1)U2^- plus projective U3^+,U3^- and the three nontrivial V4 blocks are projective; careful orientation sign is included. I reconstructed the nine mod-three sign-Hom dimensions as [[1,1,1],[1,1,2],[1,2,1]] from explicit S3 module matrices. Character/multiplicity expansion matches the ordinary averaging polynomial for H4, and exact sample Betti numbers at (7,7),(7,8),(8,8) are 1911,5726,16716. UCT gives H4(F3)-rank H4(Z)=dim Tor(H3(Z),F3)=0. All parameter values rely on the universal module polynomial identity, not finite sample extrapolation.
